title: freetokens offer front-matter
description: Strict schema for offers/*.yaml front-matter. One flat key/value document per offer; the file name (without extension) is the offer slug.

title.description: Human-readable offer name shown on cards.

provider.description: Company or product offering the credit.

amount.description: Free value in human terms, e.g. '$300 in credits'.

expiry_date.description: Date the offer stops being claimable, YYYY-MM-DD. Use explicit null for ongoing offers.

source_url.description: Official provider page describing the offer.

verified_date.description: Date the curator last verified the offer is live, YYYY-MM-DD. Not nullable.

verification.description: How the listing was checked: hand_verified = confirmed by the maintainer on the official provider page; social_proof = corroborated by official-site info plus social proof, not personally verified; unverified = only social-media proofs, no official-website confirmation.

signup.description: Whether claiming needs an account: none = claimable without sign-up; required = needs a (free) account.
